_comment: QI Executor whitelist — THE security boundary for remote script execution. Scripts must be plain filenames living in this folder (C:\QIH\dispatch\scripts). sha256='ANY' is acceptable while a script is still changing; pin the real hash once it is stable (PowerShell: (Get-FileHash .\Setup-SynVox.ps1).Hash) so a modified script refuses to run until re-approved. NEVER put secrets in a script or in this file — API keys live in machine environment variables (setx).

setup-synvox.description: SynVox Phase 0 - MatrAIx engine bootstrap: prerequisites (git/uv/Python 3.12/Node 20+), Docker check-only, clone MatrAIx into C:\APPS\SynVox\engine\matraix, uv venv + editable installs, Persona 1M dataset download, free Docker smoke test. Idempotent and master-logged to C:\APPS\SynVox\logs. Never runs a paid persona simulation.

synvox-smoke.description: SynVox Phase 0 acceptance gate - FREE. Runs 'matraix smoke' (upstream host-lane onboarding smoke) over every Survey task in the engine: loads the questionnaire, renders a persona, runs the real survey runner against a deterministic fake client, checks the answer envelope. No Docker, no provider calls, no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, cost $0 - it CANNOT spend money. Answers are synthetic and not persona-faithful: this proves the harness works, it is never a simulation result. Logs to C:\APPS\SynVox\logs\synvox_smoke_<timestamp>.log.

qi-health-snapshot.description: Read-only QI machine health snapshot: every QI_* Windows service state, disk space per drive, and a /health probe of every registered project port. Logs to C:\QIH\logs\qi_health_<timestamp>.log.
